works.body:
Hello teacher!
Can you draw my CP?

[CP] ICHIRO x ALEX 
Guard x Emperor / Moon x Sun

Alex (受け, 185 cm) 
- The emperor of a kingdom. A selfless leader who is driven by the greater good.  
- From afar, he’s bright and warm. Up close, he’s a force of nature. Life-giving, but also burning and overwhelming. 
- Someone who feels very strongly. Due to his position, he often has to commit cruel but necessary acts, which causes him to feel guilt and anger towards himself.
- Note the tan skin, gold-coloured eyes, and the burn scar on one side of his body. He has a handsome face.
- Motif: gold, blazing fire, burning sun.  

Ichiro (攻め, 185 cm) 
- A killer who works in secret for the emperor. 
- Hardworking and simple. He’s unremarkable, but impossible to ignore once noticed.
- Amoral at the core but is perceptive enough to know what others want of him. He plays the role of a kind and considerate person around those he cares for.
- He is detached from the emotions and ideals but secretly craves attachment and a place to belong in.
- Note the dark blue hair and sea-coloured eyes. He has a kind face.
- Motif: tranquil sea, clear sky, moon.  

Despite being exact opposites, Alex and Ichiro are partners.  To Ichiro, Alex is a beacon. His guiding light. To Alex, Ichiro is an anchor. His grounding force.
They have a push-pull dynamic. For example, Ichiro likes to tease Alex and Alex always reciprocates it with a fond but helpless smile. 

Feel free to draw them in any outfit, pose, and composition!
